_comment: Capability registry. Every entry in a role card's `capabilities` list must come from here. The adapter maps each id to tool-specific tool names via adapters/<tool>/capability-map.json. `ask-human` is only valid on roles with kind: hub (subagents cannot interrupt the user).

read-files.description: Read files from the project working tree (not external paths).

search-files.description: Grep / glob over the project working tree.

edit-artefacts.description: Write files, but only under .mxagent/artefacts/. Read roles use this to persist analysis reports.

shell-read.description: Run read-only shell commands (ls, cat, git log, git status).

mxcli-read.description: Invoke mxcli with READ-classified subcommands (show, describe, lint, check, ...).

mxcli-write.description: Invoke mxcli with WRITE-classified subcommands (exec, fmt, rename, ...). Only allowed on roles whose `owns` lists the matching write classes.

web-read.description: Fetch and search the public web (for mxcli / Mendix docs lookups).

delegate.description: Spawn one of the roles listed in `delegates_to`. Only valid on kind: hub.

ask-human.description: Prompt the user for input. Only valid on kind: hub — subagents never interrupt the user.
